note: T2 机制链（M1 产出，机器可读）。granularity=public 的 claim 可直接进公开 repo/报告；granularity=report 的 claim 在提交报告（官方私密渠道）中展开为 HGVS+残基级，公开仓库保持基因/结构域级。validate_chain.py 强制：每条 ev_refs 必须存在于 research/evidence.jsonl；引用 conflict 状态条目必须带 conflict_note。

nodes.claim: Proband carries a biallelic BUB1B genotype: one truncating (nonsense) allele and one missense allele in the kinase domain (compound heterozygous) — confirmed as the official Track 1 answer (full match).
The nonsense allele is a functional null: it lies in an NMD-sensitive exon, and truncating BUB1B transcripts are degraded by nonsense-mediated decay in MVA patients (patient-derived evidence).

The missense allele is best interpreted as a protein-destabilizing hypomorph: MVA1 kinase-domain missense alleles act primarily by lowering BUBR1 protein abundance (5-10x, proteasomal clearance, HSP90-dependent folding), not by abolishing catalysis; kinase activity itself is dispensable for checkpoint signaling.
nodes.counter_note: Suijkerbuijk evidence is from transfected-overexpression systems; endogenous patient-cell validation is limited; kinase-activity minority view (Mao 2003) exists [EV-0044].

nodes.claim: This genotype matches the literature rule for surviving MVA1: a truncating/null allele paired with a missense allele in or near the kinase domain; two complete nulls have never been reported.

Net consequence is BUBR1 protein insufficiency in a dose-dependent regime: ~13% expression preserves segregation fidelity whereas ~6% causes mis-segregation in most cells (cell-level thresholds); mouse dose-response gives small stature, cancer predisposition, progeroid features.
Insufficient BUBR1 weakens the spindle assembly checkpoint (MCC-mediated APC/C inhibition), shortening mitosis with premature sister chromatid separation (PSCS).
Checkpoint leakage produces mosaic variegated aneuploidy — random gains/losses across ~25-50% of cells; affected embryos show >50% aneuploid cells.

Aneuploidy burden triggers massive progenitor apoptosis depleting progenitor pools -> tissue hypoplasia -> IUGR/SGA, failure to thrive, short stature (proband HPO: HP:0004322, HP:0001508, SGA; growth retardation is the most frequent MVA feature, 93.5%).
nodes.conflict_note: EV-0051's conflict status concerns its cancer-penetrance figure, not the growth-retardation frequency (93.5%) used here; growth figure is a direct Table-1 tally.

nodes.claim: Parental recurrent pregnancy loss is mechanistically consistent: BubR1-null embryos die E7.5-E13.5 with MVA/PSCS; SAC insufficiency is predicted to underlie a significant fraction of human RPL; recurrence is 25% per conception (autosomal recessive carriers).
nodes.counter_note: RPL attribution is the authors' inference, not proven [EV-0056].

nodes.claim: Cancer predisposition: Wilms tumor most frequent, rhabdomyosarcoma second (proband's index feature, embryonal type in original BUB1B families); overall malignancy reported at 38.7% (12/31 case series) with sources ranging up to ~75%.
nodes.conflict_note: Cancer penetrance figures conflict across sources (38.7% case-series tally vs ~75% Orphanet) [EV-0051]; report must present the range with sourcing.

nodes.claim: BubR1 insufficiency drives a progeroid/sarcopenia axis (muscle wasting, dwarfism, cataracts); sarcopenia correlates with mTORC1 hyperactivity and p19Arf-dependent senescence — a druggable parallel axis distinct from chromosome segregation.
nodes.counter_note: mTORC1 link established in mice only; no pediatric MVA1 muscle data [EV-0057].

nodes.claim: Proband's nephrocalcinosis has no published MVA/BUB1B association (literature zero-hit) — reported as a novel/unexplained observation, not a mechanism claim.
nodes.counter_note: Negative literature search does not exclude an association; nephrocalcinosis may be an independent comorbidity (e.g., prematurity-related) rather than MVA1 biology — explicitly not claimed as mechanism.

nodes.claim: Beyond tumor susceptibility, MVA entails cellular and systemic stress including a chronic immune response (2024 authoritative review) — a potentially modifiable disease component distinct from chromosome segregation.
nodes.counter_note: Which clinical manifestations (growth failure severity, symptom burden) are attributable to systemic immune activation in MVA1 patients is not established.

nodes.claim: BubR1 protein abundance is controlled by the SIRT2–NAD+ deacetylase axis: SIRT2 overexpression or NAD+ precursor (NMN) treatment raises BubR1 abundance in vivo — a pharmacological route to the protein-insufficiency node (N5), complementing the genetic proof that raising BubR1 is protective.
nodes.counter_note: NMN evidence is from BubR1-insufficient aging mice, not MVA missense mutants; NMN is not an approved drug — approved NAD+ precursors would carry an evidence-transfer gap.
